RealStack AI | Senior Software Engineer | NYC | Onsite Full-time | Apply here https://forms.gle/X9CzYDBWSGYZnww57

Commercial Real Estate (CRE) is the world’s largest asset class. The annual transaction volume is 10% of US GDP, yet the industry remains slow and archaic because data is locked in PDFs and Excel files. We are transforming CRE into an AI-native asset class by helping investors understand their own assets better.

*We are hiring in NYC:*

Senior/Staff AI/IE engineer (NYC)

- Architect RAG/prompt systems to parse heterogeneous structured data. - Develop frameworks connecting LLMs to quantifiable investment decisions. - Collaborate with finance experts to translate domain knowledge into code.

Senior/Staff Full-stack engineer (NYC)

- Own the infrastructure and UI that power high-value investment decisions. - Design scalable data pipelines and cloud architecture. - Tackle complex business logic with domain-driven design.

*Who are you:*

- You build things for fun, obsess over craft, and have a lot of product ideas. - You have proven experience shipping production software to solve *ambiguous business problems*. - You have experience with end-to-end NLP/IE and complex data extraction.
